physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the spleen, the body's listening organ. The spleen is small, tucked behind the ribs on the left, and most people only learn it is there when it is hurt. It does its work in the dark. It tastes the blood. It reads what is coming, what is foreign, what is friendly, what is finished, and it does this without ever bringing the question up to the mind. It is the oldest hearing a body has, and it predates ears.

The shadow has its floor here. When the long hum of unease is running, the spleen is what is humming. A tightness on the left side under the ribs, a held breath that never fully lets out, a low animal vigilance that the mind hears as worry. The body has been picking up the wind for so long that the picking-up has gone sour into bracing. The hum is not noise the body is making, it is the noise of an instrument left in tune and never played.

The climb out is bodily too. The leaning the gift describes is felt here first, just under the ribs, a quiet yes or no with no words attached. It arrives before the mind can assemble the case. Following it loosens the grip, and the breath drops, and the side softens. The intuition is not in the head. It is in the spleen, and it has been there the whole time, waiting for the thinking to quiet enough to be heard.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Alanine. Alanine is one of the small set the body builds for itself out of what is already in the room. It is made on the spot, traded between muscle and liver, recycled, made again. It is the chemistry of the ordinary, the molecule that does not need to be sought out or brought in from far away.

There is a teaching in that, sitting close to the bone. The code of intuition rests on a molecule whose whole quality is being already here, already available, already made. The fine signal the gift describes is not arriving from somewhere else. It is not a higher frequency being beamed in. It is the body doing what the body has always been doing, in language the body has always been using, and the only news is that you are finally listening. The code runs all the way to this: a knowing that was never elsewhere.
